input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

Likely cause: the new Windows export tool produces CRLF (`\r\n`) line endings. `parseStatement` only splits on `"\n"`, so each line (including the header) keeps a trailing `\r`. That makes the last header field become `"description\r"`, which no longer matches `REQUIRED_COLUMNS`, so `assertShape` fails on the header (index 0 → reported as row 1) with "Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header" — exactly what's reported. The parser needs to strip `\r` (e.g. split on `/\r?\n/` or trim each line) to handle CRLF input.
